title: M3 N1 semantic normalization result and retained failure packets
description: Adopted YWE N1 application transport with exact headers, complete original/actual validity payloads, separate inherited and new diagnostic prefixes, immediate computation/post-validation order and closed retaining outcomes. Schema acceptance does not prove original receipt authenticity, full-profile equality, selected-target policy, actual XOR, dynamic record/reference equality or collector acknowledgement.

FieldPath.description: Closed local N1 interface field paths, not an upstream ASH rule taxonomy.

NormalizationContext.description: Runtime verifies that computation_reference and post_validation_reference differ from one another and from the inherited detection reference. operation_reference has no additional inequality constraint.

NormalizationStep.description: One observed full-vector application; runtime verifies actual_state equals input_state XOR codeword.

OperationEnvelope.description: The adopted local N1 STATE_VALIDITY/RECOVERY mapping retains exactly ten canonical envelope fields and seven permitted rule identities. It is distinct from the unchanged six-ID assessment envelope. Runtime proves actual evaluation, complete parent/root/subject correspondence and receipt truth.

ApplicationPlanValidation.description: Exact twelve-field application observation with a nonnull submitted headered plan and required submitted diagnosis. The nullable-plan exception witness is outside this wire format. Runtime establishes equality with result.plan/original_diagnosis, current complete bindings, rederived facts and the actual failed comparison.

PendingComputationRecord.description: An actual value computation pending its subsequent post-validation; a BLOCKED refusal or begin failure cannot precede POST_VALIDATION.

ResolvedPostValidationRecord.description: Completed post-validation of a successful value result; resolution does not reduce inherited severity.

BlockedPostValidationRecord.description: Completed post-validation that refused normalized output, retaining any complete actual diagnosis row.

CompletedPostValidationRecord.description: A retained attempted post-validation record. A non-VALID actual diagnosis requires BLOCKED. For VALID, runtime determines RESOLVED versus BLOCKED from actual==selected target; VALID alone cannot certify success.
